subject: DI02005021

body.en:
Definition

A unit operation primarily changes a physical condition or separates/transports material; a unit process involves a chemical reaction changing composition.

Classification

  • Mechanical operations: crushing, screening, filtration, mixing and conveying; other physical operations include heating, distillation and drying.
  • Unit processes include oxidation, nitration and polymerisation. A plant may combine reaction and physical separation; classify the main mechanism, not the equipment name alone.

Explanation

  • Crushing limestone changes size, not chemical identity; calcination changes CaCO3 chemically. Filtration separates suspended solids without necessarily reacting them.
  • Mechanical operations use particle size, shape, density, surface, electrical or magnetic response. Material/energy balances remain necessary.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Unit operation મુખ્યત્વે ભૌતિક સ્થિતિ બદલે કે પદાર્થનું વિભાજન/પરિવહન કરે; unit processમાં chemical reactionથી રચના બદલાય.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Mechanical operationsમાં crushing, screening, filtration, mixing, conveying; અન્ય physical operationsમાં heating, distillation, drying.
  • Unit processમાં oxidation, nitration, polymerisation. Plantમાં reaction સાથે physical separation પણ હોય; મુખ્ય mechanismથી ઓળખો.

સમજણ

  • Limestone crushingથી કદ બદલાય, chemical identity નહીં; calcinationમાં CaCO3 બદલાય. Filtration suspended solidsને reaction વિના જુદાં કરે.
  • Mechanical operationsમાં size, shape, density, surface, electrical/magnetic responseનો ઉપયોગ થાય; material/energy balances જરૂરી રહે.

body.en:
Definition

Particle density is mass per particle-envelope volume excluding spaces between particles. Bulk density is mass per occupied bulk-bed volume including interparticle voids.

Explanation

  • ρp=m/Vparticles; ρb=m/Vbulk. State whether internal pores are counted: skeletal, true and apparent densities are not automatically interchangeable.
  • For consistent particle-volume bases, ε=Vvoid/Vbulk=1−ρb/ρp. Loose and tapped bulk densities differ because packing changes.
  • Use particle density in settling/particle counts; bulk density in storage and conveyor load estimates. SI unit is kg/m³.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Particle densityમાં particles વચ્ચેની જગ્યા સિવાયના particle-volume દીઠ mass લેવાય; bulk densityમાં voids સહિત આખા bed-volume દીઠ mass લેવાય.

સમજણ

  • ρp=m/Vparticles; ρb=m/Vbulk. અંદરના pores ગણ્યા છે કે નહીં જણાવો; skeletal, true, apparent density સમાન નથી.
  • સુસંગત particle-volume આધાર હોય તો ε=Vvoid/Vbulk=1−ρb/ρp. Packing બદલાતાં loose/tapped bulk density જુદી પડે.
  • Settling/particle countમાં particle density; storage/conveyor loadમાં bulk density. SI એકમ kg/m³.

body.en:
Definition

An equivalent diameter is the diameter of a sphere matching a stated particle property. Sphericity ψ is the equal-volume sphere area divided by actual particle area.

Classification

  • Volume-equivalent dv=(6Vp/π)^(1/3); surface-equivalent ds=(Ap/π)^(1/2). State the basis; an irregular particle has no unique equivalent diameter.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. State the basis:Vp is the particle volume and Ap its actual external area.The equal-volume sphere defines dv; do not assume the sieve opening equals dv.
  2. Sphere volume πdv³/6=Vp.Rearranging, dv³=6Vp/π, so dv=(6Vp/π)^(1/3).
  3. The surface of that sphere is As=πdv².Sphericity is ψ=As/Ap=πdv²/Ap, a dimensionless ratio.
  4. For a cube of side a, Vp=a³ and Ap=6a².Therefore dv=(6/π)^(1/3)a.
  5. Substitute in ψ:ψ=π(6/π)^(2/3)a²/(6a²)=(π/6)^(1/3)≈0.806.The size a cancels, as expected for a shape factor.
  6. Final interpretation:ψ=1 for a sphere and ψ≤1 for a physically consistent equal-volume surface basis.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

નિર્ધારિત propertyમાં સમાન sphereનો વ્યાસ equivalent diameter છે. સમાન volumeવાળા sphereનું area/વાસ્તવિક particle area એટલે sphericity ψ.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Volume માટે dv=(6Vp/π)^(1/3); surface માટે ds=(Ap/π)^(1/2). આધાર જણાવો; irregular particleનો એકમાત્ર equivalent diameter નથી.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Basis:Vp particle volume, Ap actual external area; equal-volume sphereથી dv મળે.Sieve opening=dv ન માનો.
  2. Sphere volume πdv³/6=Vp; તેથી dv³=6Vp/π અને dv=(6Vp/π)^(1/3).
  3. આ sphereની surface As=πdv².Sphericity ψ=As/Ap=πdv²/Ap નિરેક ratio છે.
  4. Side aવાળા cubeમાં Vp=a³, Ap=6a²; તેથી dv=(6/π)^(1/3)a.
  5. ψમાં substitute:ψ=π(6/π)^(2/3)a²/(6a²)=(π/6)^(1/3)≈0.806.Shape factor હોવાથી a cancel થાય.
  6. Final અર્થ:sphere માટે ψ=1; સુસંગત equal-volume surface basisમાં ψ≤1.

body.en:
Definition

Mass-specific surface am is total particle external area per unit mass; volume-specific surface must state whether solid or bulk volume is used.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Assume a particle with density ρp, volume Vp and external area Ap.Mass m=ρpVp; mass-specific external surface is am=Ap/m.
  2. From the equal-volume diameter, Vp=πdv³/6; from sphericity, Ap=πdv²/ψ.
  3. Substitute:am=(πdv²/ψ)/(ρpπdv³/6)=6/(ρpψdv).
  4. For spheres ψ=1, so am=6/(ρpd).With ρp in kg/m³ and d in m, the answer is m²/kg.
  5. The solid-volume specific area is Sv=Ap/Vp=6/(ψdv), in m⁻¹.It is not area per bulk-bed volume unless voidage is included separately.
  6. For a mixture, total area divided by total mass must be used; internal pore/BET area is a different property.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

કુલ external particle area/એકમ mass એટલે mass-specific surface am; volume-specific surfaceમાં solid કે bulk volumeનો આધાર જણાવવો.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Density ρp, volume Vp, external area Apવાળા particle માટે m=ρpVp; mass-specific area am=Ap/m.
  2. Equal-volume diameterથી Vp=πdv³/6; sphericityથી Ap=πdv²/ψ.
  3. Substitute:am=(πdv²/ψ)/(ρpπdv³/6)=6/(ρpψdv).
  4. Sphereમાં ψ=1 એટલે am=6/(ρpd).ρp kg/m³ તથા d mમાં લો તો answer m²/kg મળે.
  5. Solid-volume area Sv=Ap/Vp=6/(ψdv), એકમ m⁻¹.Bulk-bed volume માટે voidage અલગથી ધ્યાનમાં લેવું પડે.
  6. Mixtureમાં total area/total mass લો; internal pore/BET area જુદો ગુણધર્મ છે.

body.en:
Definition

A mean diameter is an average weighted by a specified particle measure; different means answer different engineering questions.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. For spherical size class i, let ni be particle count and di the diameter.Total solid volume=(π/6)Σni di³, total area=πΣni di².
  2. Define Dvs as the sphere diameter giving the same total volume/area ratio:6Vtotal/Atotal=Dvs.Therefore Dvs=Σni di³/Σni di².
  3. For equal-density spheres, mi=ρpπni di³/6.Hence ni di³=6mi/(ρpπ) and ni di²=6mi/(ρpπdi).
  4. Substitute and cancel constants:Dvs=Σmi/Σ(mi/di).With xi=mi/Σmi, Dvs=1/Σ(xi/di).
  5. Mass mean is defined directly:Dm=Σmi di/Σmi=Σxi di.For equal-density spheres this also equals Σni di⁴/Σni di³=D43.
  6. Check Σxi=1 and use one size unit throughout.Equal density and spherical/consistent shape assumptions are essential for the simplified conversions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

નિર્ધારિત particle measure મુજબ weighted સરેરાશ mean diameter છે; જુદા means જુદા engineering પ્રશ્નો માટે છે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Spherical class iમાં ni count, di diameter; total volume=(π/6)Σni di³, total area=πΣni di².
  2. સમાન total volume/area ratio આપતો diameter Dvs=6Vtotal/Atotal; તેથી Dvs=Σni di³/Σni di².
  3. Equal-density spheresમાં mi=ρpπni di³/6; તેથી ni di³=6mi/(ρpπ), ni di²=6mi/(ρpπdi).
  4. Substitute/constants cancel કરતાં Dvs=Σmi/Σ(mi/di).xi=mi/Σmiથી Dvs=1/Σ(xi/di).
  5. Mass meanની વ્યાખ્યા Dm=Σmi di/Σmi=Σxi di.Equal-density spheres માટે Σni di⁴/Σni di³=D43 પણ થાય.
  6. Σxi=1 તથા એક જ size unit રાખો.Simplified conversionsમાં equal density અને spherical/consistent shape જરૂરી છે.

title.en: Number of particles in a solid

h.en: Number of particles in a solid

body.en:
Definition

Particle count is the number of discrete particles represented by a mass and a defined particle-volume distribution.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. For a spherical particle of diameter d, volume vp=πd³/6 and mass mp=ρpπd³/6.Use particle density, not bulk density.
  2. If total mass M consists of equal particles, M=Nmp.Thus N=M/mp=6M/(ρpπd³).
  3. For a mixture, the mass in class i is Mi=Mxi.One particle in that class has mass ρpiπdvi³/6.
  4. Divide class mass by particle mass:Ni=6Mxi/(ρpiπdvi³); then total N=ΣNi.
  5. Use M in kg, ρ in kg/m³ and diameters in m.The units cancel to a dimensionless count; round only after summing.
  6. For a sieve fraction, declare the representative volume-equivalent size.Open-ended pan fractions need a justified size estimate; d=0 is invalid.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Mass તથા નિર્ધારિત particle-volume distributionમાં આવેલા discrete particlesની સંખ્યા particle count છે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Spherical particle માટે vp=πd³/6, mp=ρpπd³/6.Particle density લો, bulk density નહીં.
  2. Equal particlesના total massમાં M=Nmp; તેથી N=6M/(ρpπd³).
  3. Mixtureમાં class iનું mass Mi=Mxi; એક particleનું mass ρpiπdvi³/6.
  4. Class mass/particle massથી Ni=6Mxi/(ρpiπdvi³); total N=ΣNi.
  5. M kg, ρ kg/m³, diameters mમાં લો.Units cancel થઈ count મળે; સરવાળા પછી rounding કરો.
  6. Sieve fractionમાં representative volume-equivalent size જણાવો.Pan માટે justified estimate જોઈએ; d=0 ખોટું છે.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

Given dry mass M=2kg, particle volume 0.0008m³ and poured bulk volume 0.00125m³.

To find

Find particle density, bulk density and interparticle voidage.

Governing relation and assumptions

ρp=M/Vp; ρb=M/Vb; ε=1−ρb/ρp.Use the same particle-volume basis; mass and volumes refer to one dry sample.

Calculation with substitution

  1. ρp=M/Vp=2500kg/m³; ρb=M/Vb=1600kg/m³.
  2. On the same particle-volume basis, ε=1−1600/2500=0.36=36%.
  3. Check:bulk density is smaller because interparticle voids add volume.

Final answer

ρp=2500kg/m³; ρb=1600kg/m³; ε=0.36=36%.

Unit/physical check

Vp<Vb, so ρp>ρb; 0<ε<1.M/V has kg/m³ units.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો—પ્રયોગની readings નહીં

આપેલી માહિતી

આપેલ dry mass M=2kg, particle volume 0.0008m³, poured bulk volume 0.00125m³.

શું શોધવું

Particle density, bulk density તથા interparticle voidage શોધો.

સૂત્ર તથા ધારણાઓ

ρp=M/Vp; ρb=M/Vb; ε=1−ρb/ρp.એક dry sample તથા સમાન particle-volume basis લો.

મૂલ્યો મૂકીને ગણતરી

  1. ρp=M/Vp=2500kg/m³; ρb=M/Vb=1600kg/m³.
  2. સમાન particle-volume basis પર ε=1−1600/2500=0.36=36%.
  3. ચકાસણી:interparticle voidથી volume વધે, તેથી bulk density ઓછી.

અંતિમ જવાબ

ρp=2500kg/m³; ρb=1600kg/m³; ε=0.36=36%.

એકમ તથા યોગ્યતાની ચકાસણી

Vp<Vb એટલે ρp>ρb; 0<ε<1.M/Vનો unit kg/m³.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

Cube side a=2mm; ρp=2500kg/m³.Vp=a³=8mm³; Ap=6a²=24mm².

To find

Find volume-equivalent diameter, sphericity and mass-specific external area.

Governing relation and assumptions

dv=(6Vp/π)^(1/3); ψ=πdv²/Ap; am=Ap/(ρpVp).For a cube, Vp=a³, Ap=6a².

Calculation with substitution

  1. dv=(6Vp/π)^(1/3)=2.4814mm.
  2. ψ=πdv²/Ap=0.8060 (dimensionless).
  3. Specific area am=Ap/(ρpVp)=6/(ρpa)=1.20m²/kg. Use a=0.002m.

Final answer

dv≈2.4814mm; ψ≈0.8060; am=1.20m²/kg.

Unit/physical check

Sphericity is dimensionless and below1.Convert a to metres when using SI density for am.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો—પ્રયોગની readings નહીં

આપેલી માહિતી

Cube side a=2mm; ρp=2500kg/m³.Vp=a³=8mm³; Ap=6a²=24mm².

શું શોધવું

Volume-equivalent diameter, sphericity તથા mass-specific external area શોધો.

સૂત્ર તથા ધારણાઓ

dv=(6Vp/π)^(1/3); ψ=πdv²/Ap; am=Ap/(ρpVp).Cubeમાં Vp=a³, Ap=6a².

મૂલ્યો મૂકીને ગણતરી

  1. dv=(6Vp/π)^(1/3)=2.4814mm.
  2. ψ=πdv²/Ap=0.8060 (નિરેક).
  3. Specific area am=Ap/(ρpVp)=6/(ρpa)=1.20m²/kg.a=0.002m લો.

અંતિમ જવાબ

dv≈2.4814mm; ψ≈0.8060; am=1.20m²/kg.

એકમ તથા યોગ્યતાની ચકાસણી

Sphericity નિરેક/1થી ઓછી છે.am માટે SI density સાથે a metresમાં ફેરવો.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

A 1kg sample contains spherical particles of equal density 2500kg/m³.Mass fractions x=0.2, 0.3, 0.5; diameters d=1, 2, 4mm respectively.

To find

Find Dvs, Dm, total external area per mass and estimated total count.

Governing relation and assumptions

Assume spherical classes of equal density:Dvs=1/[Σ(xi/di)]; Dm=Σxidi; am=6/(ρpDvs); N=Σ6Mxi/(ρpπdi³).

Calculation with substitution

  1. Σxi/di=0.2/1+0.3/2+0.5/4=0.475mm⁻¹; Dvs=1/0.475=2.1053mm.
  2. Dm=Σxidi=0.2×1+0.3×2+0.5×4=2.80mm.
  3. am=6/(ρpDvs)=1.14m²/kg; convert Dvs to metres.
  4. Ni=6Mxi/(ρpπdi³), with di in metres. N≈152789+28648+5968=187405 particles (rounding).
  5. A real sieve interval needs a stated representative diameter; do not substitute zero for pan size.

Final answer

Dvs=2.1053mm; Dm=2.80mm; am=1.14m²/kg; N≈187405 for1kg.

Unit/physical check

Σxi=1 and both means lie between1 and4mm.Particle count uses metres and particle density; round after summing.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો—પ્રયોગની readings નહીં

આપેલી માહિતી

1kg sampleમાં સમાન density 2500kg/m³ના spherical particles.x=0.2, 0.3, 0.5; અનુક્રમે d=1, 2, 4mm.

શું શોધવું

Dvs, Dm, mass દીઠ external area તથા estimated total count શોધો.

સૂત્ર તથા ધારણાઓ

Equal-density spherical classes માનો:Dvs=1/[Σ(xi/di)]; Dm=Σxidi; am=6/(ρpDvs); N=Σ6Mxi/(ρpπdi³).

મૂલ્યો મૂકીને ગણતરી

  1. Σxi/di=0.2/1+0.3/2+0.5/4=0.475mm⁻¹; Dvs=2.1053mm.
  2. Dm=Σxidi=0.2×1+0.3×2+0.5×4=2.80mm.
  3. am=6/(ρpDvs)=1.14m²/kg; Dvs metresમાં લો.
  4. Ni=6Mxi/(ρpπdi³), di metresમાં. N≈152789+28648+5968=187405 particles (rounded).
  5. વાસ્તવિક sieve intervalમાં representative diameter સ્પષ્ટ લો; pan માટે zero નહીં.

અંતિમ જવાબ

Dvs=2.1053mm; Dm=2.80mm; am=1.14m²/kg; 1kgમાં N≈187405.

એકમ તથા યોગ્યતાની ચકાસણી

Σxi=1; બંને means1થી4mm વચ્ચે.Countમાં metres/particle density લો; sum પછી round કરો.

body.en:
Aim and scope

  • Determine means and estimated particle count from measured sieve fractions on stated shape/density assumptions.

Instruments/materials

  • Calibrated balance, covered sieve stack/shaker, receiver, trays, known particle density and nonhazardous dry sample.

Connections/setup

  • Stack largest opening on top, smallest above pan; clamp covered stack to approved shaker with power isolated.

Procedure

  1. Weigh clean empty sieves and total sample; check that the sample is representative.
  2. Load, close/clamp and shake for the approved time; stop and isolate before removal.
  3. Weigh each retained fraction without brushing particles through the mesh; repeat if instructor requires.
  4. Select representative interval diameters; state top/pan boundary treatment before calculations.

Blank observation sheet

  • Sheet:sample mass ___g; density ___kg/m³; shape assumption ___; shake time ___s; for each interval:upper/lower opening ___mm, representative di ___mm, retained mi ___g, xi ___, xi/di ___, xidi ___.
  • Mass recovered ___g; mass-balance error ___%.No readings are supplied.

Calculations and blank result

  • xi=mi/Σmi; equal density:Dvs=1/Σ(xi/di), Dm=Σxidi. Spherical Ni=6Mxi/(ρpπdi³), N=ΣNi with SI units.
  • Result:Dvs ___mm, Dm ___mm, N ___ for sample M ___kg. If pan representative size is undefined, report that count/mean cannot be uniquely estimated.

Safe fault-finding

  • After isolation inspect loose clamps, mesh damage, blinding and sample loss; check balance zero and size assumptions.

Precautions

  • Use only the instructor-approved guarded trainer and compatible nonhazardous sample; record apparatus ID and authorised settings.
  • Isolate electrical/mechanical/pressure energy before opening, adjusting or clearing equipment; an emergency stop is not isolation.
  • Wear specified PPE, control dust/spills and follow the laboratory waste procedure; do not improvise live fault tests.
  • Do not run an unclamped/open stack or force material through the sieve.
body.gu:
હેતુ તથા મર્યાદા

  • માપેલા sieve fractionsથી shape/density assumptions મુજબ means તથા particle count.

સાધનો/પદાર્થો

  • Calibrated balance, covered sieve stack/shaker, receiver, trays, known particle density તથા dry sample.

જોડાણ/ગોઠવણ

  • Largest opening ઉપર, smallest નીચે pan ઉપર; power isolate કરી covered stack clamp કરો.

કાર્યક્રમ

  1. ખાલી sieves/કુલ sample weigh કરો; representative sample લો.
  2. Load, close/clamp; approved time shake; પછી stop/isolate કરીને કાઢો.
  3. Meshમાંથી દબાવ્યા વિના retained fraction weigh; જરૂર મુજબ repeat.
  4. Representative interval diameters લો; top/pan boundary treatment પહેલાં સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

ખાલી અવલોકન પત્રક

  • Sheet:sample mass ___g; density ___kg/m³; shape ___; shake time ___s; દર interval:upper/lower opening ___mm, di ___mm, mi ___g, xi ___, xi/di ___, xidi ___.

q.en: Define/explain: Unit operation and unit process
q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા/સમજણ: Unit Operation અને Unit Process

a.en: A unit operation primarily changes a physical condition or separates/transports material; a unit process involves a chemical reaction changing composition.
a.gu: Unit operation મુખ્યત્વે ભૌતિક સ્થિતિ બદલે કે પદાર્થનું વિભાજન/પરિવહન કરે; unit processમાં chemical reactionથી રચના બદલાય.

a.en: Particle density is mass per particle-envelope volume excluding spaces between particles. Bulk density is mass per occupied bulk-bed volume including interparticle voids.
a.gu: Particle densityમાં particles વચ્ચેની જગ્યા સિવાયના particle-volume દીઠ mass લેવાય; bulk densityમાં voids સહિત આખા bed-volume દીઠ mass લેવાય.

a.en: An equivalent diameter is the diameter of a sphere matching a stated particle property. Sphericity ψ is the equal-volume sphere area divided by actual particle area.
a.gu: નિર્ધારિત propertyમાં સમાન sphereનો વ્યાસ equivalent diameter છે. સમાન volumeવાળા sphereનું area/વાસ્તવિક particle area એટલે sphericity ψ.

a.en: Mass-specific surface am is total particle external area per unit mass; volume-specific surface must state whether solid or bulk volume is used.
a.gu: કુલ external particle area/એકમ mass એટલે mass-specific surface am; volume-specific surfaceમાં solid કે bulk volumeનો આધાર જણાવવો.
